items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: Handy wrote Mr. Crump and Jeff, to, to answer Jeff Smith's Beale Street Squabble.

ctx.x: Much younger. And then, uh, uh, the, uh, uh, and, uh, why, uh, Handy, uh, uh, what inspired Handy to write, uh, Mr. Crump, which later was, uh, changed and called Memphis Blues, was because Jeff Smith wrote a number called, uh, The Beale Street Squabble. And, uh, this number was a big hit, and in those days they paraded around in, uh, wagons and trucks with the bed. Yeah. And, uh, Handy wrote Mr. Crump and Jeff, to, to answer Jeff Smith's Beale Street Squabble. And then there, there, and then there, they began…

By the way, do you remember in any of your early days, any parades? Like in New Orleans, they used brass bands for funerals, too. You know, they still used those. They'll have the band out for a funeral. Did you ever?
